description: V&V-style requirement register for in-memory tile textures. Compatible with ai-vnv/vnvspec evidence workflows (import as data when using Python 3.11+).

requirements.statement: Procedural tile generators shall accept both numpy.random.Generator and legacy RandomState without raising.
Callable custom_tile_textures shall return H×W×3 or H×W×4 uint8 arrays with values in [0,255] suitable for GL upload.
load_texture_from_rgba shall coerce RGB to RGBA, set GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT to 1, and optionally resize to power-of-two dimensions.
On each reset, only tile kinds present on the map shall trigger materialization and at most one GL texture upload per configured key used.
suggested_tests: manual: profile reset() with large maps

requirements.statement: custom_tile_textures shall take precedence over custom_tile_texture_paths for the same logical tile.
suggested_tests: manual: pass both maps and confirm procedural pixels

requirements.statement: Registered env Duckietown-zigzag_dists_mining_prog-v0 shall reset and produce rgb_array observations without corruption (finite, expected shape).
max_side shall cap texture resolution before upload to avoid exceeding GL_MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE on constrained GPUs.
suggested_tests: future: parametrize load_texture_from_rgba with large synthetic array
